text: amy: dropping a compact-dashboard mock. problem: axis tick SI units (1.2M) + wrapping legends make the grid feel chaotic on narrow widths. want quick takes. ben: can you paste the figma link/frame id? amy: https://www.figma.com/file/preview — variant A uses compact units + single-line ellipses, variant B uses full numbers and stacked legends. also added a per-chart smoothing toggle in header (default TBD). cora: single-line ellipses preferred for density, but we must make full values accessible. keyboard-focusable numbers that reveal a persistent tooltip on focus. aria-label should spell out the number. dmitri: agree. accessibility snippet suggestion: 1.23M (no role="img"). amy: noted. outlier handling: current mock dims spikes by opacity, which hides events. alternative: cap y-axis at configurable percentile (default 99) and render a dashed truncated spike for clipped series + small overflow badge at chart corner to open inline details. ben: love cap+badge. microcopy for badge action: "View full range". less scary than "Include outliers". cora: design detail: show clipped spikes as dashed stubs so trend is visible. badge should be keyboard-focusable with aria-expanded toggling the inline panel. panel must contain a textual table of exact values. dmitri: perf note: only draw dashed extension for series that exceed the cap and batch canvas draws. also persist smoothing preference per-dashboard in localStorage initially. amy: figma-bot: uploaded image 1845550018 (compact-grid-badge.png) ben: tiny legend UX: keep left-aligned single-line items, truncate with ellipsis, and show full metric on focus via tooltip. add a tiny "Show all" affordance to expand legend into multi-line when needed. cora: QA/accessibility checklist: 1) compact numbers are focusable and announced with spelled-out aria-labels 2) overflow badge is role="button" with aria-label announcing clipped value 3) inline panel reachable by keyboard and lists exact numbers 4) legend items focusable with tooltip on focus 5) smoothing toggle default OFF. amy: action items: 1) design: mock dashed truncation + overflow badge + inline panel (amy) 2) dev: aria-label pattern for compact numbers + localStorage for smoothing (ben) 3) dev: badge role/button + panel keyboard behavior (dmitri) 4) copy: use "View full range" for badge (cora) ben: i'll start a PR for the aria-label pattern and localStorage key. dmitri will sketch the badge interactions in the component lib. amy: thanks all — i'll post updated frames by tomorrow AM. :sparkles:
